claim_text: Fleischman said that the reported/video-shared attack on a Palestinian on Jerusalem Day was fake.
discovery_sources: The Seventh Eye 2024 Channel 14 report PDF; Channel 13 'Election Zone' capture published 2023-06-18; Times of Israel/Jerusalem Post/Forward May 18 Jerusalem Day reporting; renewed Hebrew/English Channel 14 searches
resolution_notes: Evidence strengthened but does not yet support a safe verdict. The Seventh Eye's original report PDF preserves Fleischman's exact wording and states that the referenced Palestinian assault was documented on video, alongside additional attacks on journalists. Independent contemporaneous reporting confirms multiple assaults/clashes involving Palestinians and journalists during the May 18 Jerusalem Day march, including at least one filmed assault on Palestinian residents. However, multiple distinct incidents exist and this pass still did not recover Fleischman's exact original Channel 14 broadcast/date or uniquely identify which assault/video he meant. Preserve recurring-panelist origin and keep Unresolved rather than matching the claim to a merely plausible incident or forcing an adverse verdict.
media_status: Secondary exact-capture/PDF evidence strengthened; original Channel 14 broadcast remains Blocked. No generic or merely related Jerusalem Day imagery used.
